title: CallEdgeContribution
description: A call-site edge from a calling function/method to a callee, lifted from a call graph (e.g. joern). Pattern-C universal slot (§8bis Rule 2). Producers (techno-specific KSs, Rule 1): `JoernKS` today; future per-language analyzers populate the same envelope.

fromSymbol.description: SCIP symbol id of the source endpoint (must resolve to a Index.ScipSymbol (or other code-bearing slot) in this Bb).

toSymbol.description: SCIP symbol id of the target endpoint (must resolve to a Index.ScipSymbol (or other code-bearing slot) in this Bb).

callSite.description: Optional path/range of the call site.

isVirtual.description: True when dispatch is dynamic and the resolved callee is one of multiple candidates.
